title: Entity form and validation
status: gate met - all six criteria: validation blocks the save before any gateway call, decimals keep exact precision, reference pickers list only active codes from the LOV service, keys and audit columns are read-only, defaults come from the defaults service scoped to the table, and messages are localised and name the field

implementation.form: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Ppdm/OgEntityForm.cs (OgFormFieldKind, OgFormField, OgFormDefinition, OgFormProblem, OgEntityForm.Build/Validate/Convert, OgFormMessages en+ar)
implementation.saveGate: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Ppdm/OgEntityFormService.cs (validate then write; WriteAttempts counts gateway calls)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/EntityFormPageView.cs (route 'entityform': generated fields, read-only keys/audit, Save as new / Save changes, validation list)

gates.AC-1 mandatory violation blocks the save: pass - OgEntityFormService validates first and returns form-invalid without touching the gateway; a test with a counting gateway asserts zero gateway calls and zero write attempts when WELL_NAME is missing, and the smoke shows the problem naming NAME with the form still unwritten.
gates.AC-2 decimal precision is preserved exac: pass - Decimal fields are parsed with decimal.Parse from invariant text and the converted value is asserted to be a decimal equal to 1234.5678901234567890123, printed back with every digit; no double is involved anywhere on the path.
gates.AC-3 reference pickers list only active: pass - OgLovFormLookups reads the LOV service by value type (the column), keeps only ActiveInd = Y and falls back to the code when a label is blank; the page renders a ComboBox for a field that has lookup values. Tests prove inactive codes are dropped, a blank code is dropped and a blank label becomes the code; the smoke shows the source is resolved from the host (form-lookups-wired true).
gates.AC-4 audit and system columns are never: pass - ROW_CHANGED_BY, ROW_CHANGED_DATE, ROW_CREATED_BY, ROW_CREATED_DATE, ROW_EFFECTIVE_DATE, ROW_EXPIRY_DATE, ROW_QUALITY and PPDM_GUID are marked read-only (as are key columns), EditableFields excludes them, the page renders them with IsReadOnly, and the smoke reports form-audit-readonly true.
gates.AC-5 defaults come from the owning servi: pass - OgDefaultValueFormDefaults reads PPDMDefaultValueService and keeps only the keys prefixed with this table, so another table's default cannot leak into the form. A generated field carries the value as Default, the page pre-fills it (and preselects a picker value), and a test asserts a default never lands on a key or an audit column; the smoke shows form-defaults-wired true.
gates.AC-6 validation messages are localized a: pass - every message takes the field's label and exists in English and Arabic; a test asserts the Arabic sentence still names 'Well Name', and the smoke shows 'Name is required.' with problem field NAME.

limits: The LOV and defaults services are constructed in Desktop.Data (OgFormSourceFactory) because FND-02 AC-4 forbids IDMEEditor outside that project; the guard test caught the first attempt at wiring them in the bootstrapper.
Update on the page guards only on the key columns it can see; the full original-row guard is available at the gateway and used by the workbench.
The page is not covered by an automated UI test beyond construction in the smoke; the form logic is unit-tested and the save path is proven with a counting gateway.
Field kinds are inferred from the CLR type (text/integer/decimal/date/boolean); there is no lookup, multi-select or file field.
The form shows one flat list of fields; the plan's sectioned layout and wizard steps are not implemented.
